steps.note: Expand: add nullable total (metadata only, no rewrite) and drop NOT NULL from amount so the app can later stop writing it. Short lock_timeout with retries so a waiting ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock never queues app queries for long. Fails here, before any deploy, if total already exists.
steps.sql: SET lock_timeout = '300ms'; DO $$ BEGIN FOR i IN 1..100 LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN total numeric(10,2), ALTER COLUMN amount DROP NOT NULL; RETURN; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(0.2 + random() * 0.5); END; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'could not lock orders'; END $$;

steps.note: Make total NOT NULL without a long blocking scan: add a NOT VALID check (brief lock, retried), then validate it under SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, which does not block the app's reads or inserts. Validation fails, stopping the plan, if any row was missed.
steps.sql: SET lock_timeout = '300ms'; DO $$ BEGIN FOR i IN 1..100 LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null CHECK (total IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID; RETURN; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(0.2 + random() * 0.5); END; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'could not lock orders'; END $$; SET statement_timeout = 0; SET lock_timeout = '5s'; ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null;

steps.note: SET NOT NULL uses the validated check instead of scanning (PG 12+), then the helper check is dropped. Brief lock, retried.
steps.sql: SET lock_timeout = '300ms'; DO $$ BEGIN FOR i IN 1..100 LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN total SET NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null; RETURN; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(0.2 + random() * 0.5); END; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'could not lock orders'; END $$;

steps.note: App reads total, still writes both, so old pods still reading amount during the rollout see correct values for new rows.
App reads and writes total only (amount is nullable now, so inserts without it succeed).

Contract: drop amount (metadata only). Brief lock, retried.
